title: Contract Extraction Schema
description: Unified schema for benchmarking contract understanding AI tools (Extracta.ai and Azure Document Intelligence)

fields.description: What is the contract number or agreement ID?
What is the title of this contract or agreement?
examples: Master Services Agreement for Security Assessment Services

fields.description: Who are all the parties involved in this contract? List their full legal names.
When does this contract become effective or start? (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD)
When does this contract expire or end? (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD, or null if no fixed expiration)
What is the duration or term of this contract?
What is the total value, price, or monetary amount of this contract?

total.description: Total contract value or annual value

breakdown.description: Brief breakdown of major cost components

examples.breakdown: Annual fee: External testing ($240k), Internal assessment ($125k), Social engineering ($45k), Web app testing ($72k), Emergency retainer ($5.5k)

fields.description: What is the subject matter or purpose of this contract? What services or products are being provided?
examples: Provider furnishes enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure, platform, and managed database services to Customer, a multinational banking institution.
Consultant provides security assessment services including quarterly penetration testing, annual internal assessments, and social engineering campaigns.

fields.description: What jurisdiction or governing law applies to this contract?
What are the key obligations or responsibilities mentioned in this contract?
examples: 99.99% uptime SLA with tiered service credits for failures
Data residency in EU/UK and Singapore regions with GDPR compliance
RPO of 15 minutes and RTO of 4 hours for disaster recovery
Quarterly business reviews and dedicated Technical Account Manager
SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS Level 1 compliance

notes: This schema is designed for short (1-2 page) contract excerpts
All dates should be normalized to ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)
Parties should be listed as they appear in the contract (full legal names)
Key obligations should capture the most critical terms and SLAs
